purpose: Assess whether the intraday-stop engine's existing bar validation accepts the frozen tape, without simulating trades or calculating returns
validator_cross_check: The six flagged bars were each passed to _validate_stop_bars; each raised the expected error.
scope: All source rows, not an instantiated strategy universe or a calendar-complete panel. Only timestamp, symbol, open, high, low and close were read. Absent symbol-date rows are not counted.
method: Count rows where all four fields are NaN; among remaining rows count any nonfinite or nonpositive field. For fully finite positive rows, flag low > min(open, close) * (1 + 1e-10) or high < max(open, close) * (1 - 1e-10), matching _validate_stop_bars. Percent discrepancies are computed against the smaller or larger endpoint respectively.
limits: Labels are tape labels, not verified security identities. The method does not test source accuracy, market halts, corporate actions, missing symbol-date rows, or actual fills. It does not establish whether a particular run includes these bars. No rows were repaired or discarded.
